logicNodes.label: Axis 1 [$[action_left]]/[$[action_right]]
logicNodes.description: Outputs a standard value between -1 and 1, controlled using [$[action_left]] and [$[action_right]]. [$[action_left]] causes the output value to move towards -1, and [$[action_right]] moves it towards 1.

logicNodes.label: Axis 2 [$[action_up]]/[$[action_down]]
logicNodes.description: Outputs a standard value between -1 and 1, controlled using [$[action_up]] and [$[action_down]]. [$[action_down]] causes the output value to move towards -1, and [$[action_up]] moves it towards 1.

logicNodes.label: Axis 3 [$[action_pedal_left]]/[$[action_pedal_right]]
logicNodes.description: Outputs a standard value between -1 and 1, controlled using [$[action_pedal_left]] and [$[action_pedal_right]]. [$[action_pedal_left]] causes the output value to move towards -1, and [$[action_pedal_right]] moves it towards 1.

logicNodes.label: Axis 4 [$[action_throttle_up]]/[$[action_throttle_down]]
logicNodes.description: Outputs a standard value between -1 and 1, controlled using [$[action_throttle_up]] and [$[action_throttle_down]]. [$[action_throttle_down]] causes the output value to move towards -1, and [$[action_throttle_up]] moves it towards 1.

logicNodes.label: Seat data
logicNodes.description: Outputs the axis, hotkey and occupied data from the helm. (On/Off 1+ : Hotkeys) (On/Off 31 : Trigger) (On/Off 32 : Occupied) (Value 1 : [$[action_left]]/[$[action_right]]) (Value 2 : [$[action_up]]/[$[action_down]]) (Value 3 : [$[action_pedal_left]]/[$[action_pedal_right]]) (Value 4 : [$[action_throttle_up]]/[$[action_throttle_down]]) (Value 9 : Look X)  (Value 10 : Look Y)

Less-Than.description: Outputs an on signal if the first input is less than the second, and outputs an off signal if the first input is greater than or equal to the second.

logicNodes.label: A LESS THAN B
logicNodes.description: Outputs an on signal if A is less than B. Outputs an off signal if A is greater than or equal to B.

logicNodes.label: A

logicNodes.label: B

Memory_Register.name: Memory Register
Memory_Register.description: The number input will be stored when an on signal is received. A secondary on/off signal can be used to clear the stored value, resetting it to the configured value set using the select tool.
Memory_Register.shortDescription: A memory register that can store a number value.

logicNodes.label: Set
logicNodes.description: Stores the input value when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Clear
logicNodes.description: Resets the stored value to 0.

logicNodes.label: Value to Store
logicNodes.description: The value that will be stored when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Stored Value
logicNodes.description: The value that is stored in the memory.

Modulo.name: Modulo
Modulo.shortDescription: Takes two number inputs, outputs the remainder after dividing the first by the second.

logicNodes.label: A
logicNodes.description: The value to modulo.

logicNodes.label: B
logicNodes.description: The value to modulo A by.

logicNodes.label: A % B
logicNodes.description: Outputs the remainder when A is divided by B.

Multiply.name: Multiply
Multiply.shortDescription: Takes two number inputs, multiplies them together, and outputs the result.

logicNodes.label: A
logicNodes.description: The value to be multiplied.

logicNodes.label: B
logicNodes.description: The value to multiply by.

logicNodes.label: A x B
logicNodes.description: Outputs the result of multiplying A by B.

Not.name: Not
Not.description: The output will always be the opposite of the input.
Not.shortDescription: A logic gate that outputs the logical NOT of its input signal.

logicNodes.label: A
logicNodes.description: The signal to invert.

logicNodes.label: NOT A
logicNodes.description: The logical NOT of input A. This output will always be the opposite of the input.

Numerical_Inverter.name: Numerical Inverter
Numerical_Inverter.shortDescription: The inverter takes a number as input, multiplies it by -1, and outputs the result.

logicNodes.label: Number to Invert
logicNodes.description: The number that will be inverted.

logicNodes.label: Inverted Number
logicNodes.description: The inverse of the input. This is equivalent to multiplying the input by -1.

Numerical_Junction.name: Numerical Junction
Numerical_Junction.description: The junction can be switched using an on/off signal. When the signal is on, the number is passed through to the first output and a value of 0 is passed to the second. When the signal is off, the number is passed through to the second output with the first being set to 0.
Numerical_Junction.shortDescription: Acts as a junction for two number signals.

logicNodes.label: Switch Signal
logicNodes.description: Controls which of the two output paths the input value will be sent to.

logicNodes.label: Value to Pass Through
logicNodes.description: The value to pass through the junction.

logicNodes.label: On Path
logicNodes.description: Receives the input value when the switch signal is set to on.

logicNodes.label: Off Path
logicNodes.description: Receives the input value when the switch signal is set to off.

Numerical_Switchbox.name: Numerical Switchbox
Numerical_Switchbox.description: Which of the two inputs is sent to the output is determined by the on/off switch signal. When the signal is on, the first value is sent to the output. When it is off, the second output is sent.
Numerical_Switchbox.shortDescription: Acts as a switchbox for two number signals.

logicNodes.label: Switch Signal
logicNodes.description: Controls which of the two input values will be sent to the output.

logicNodes.label: First Value (On)
logicNodes.description: The value to output when the switch signal is on.

logicNodes.label: Second Value (Off)
logicNodes.description: The value to output when the switch signal is off.

logicNodes.label: Switched Value
logicNodes.description: Outputs the first value when the switch signal is on, and the second value when it is off.

Or.name: Or
Or.description: The output will be switched on if either of the inputs is on, and off if neither are on.
Or.shortDescription: A logic gate that outputs the logical OR of two input signals.

logicNodes.label: A
logicNodes.description: The first value to perform the logical OR on.

logicNodes.label: B
logicNodes.description: The second value to perform the logical OR on.

logicNodes.label: A OR B
logicNodes.description: Outputs an on signal when either A or B are on, and an off signal if neither are on.

PID_Controller.name: PID Controller
PID_Controller.description: It takes the current measured output of a system or sensor, and a desired target measurement. It outputs a value that can be used as an input to the system to gradually correct its error. For example, the controller could input to an engine's throttle to maintain a desired speed or altitude. The control terms (proportional, integral and derivative) can be set by selecting the component with the select tool. The control terms must be carefully tuned for optimal output.
PID_Controller.shortDescription: A control loop feedback mechanism that measures and corrects the error in a system over time.

logicNodes.label: Active
logicNodes.description: Sets whether or not the controller is active. When inactive, stored values are reset.

logicNodes.label: Process Variable
logicNodes.description: The current measured value of the system.

logicNodes.label: Setpoint
logicNodes.description: The desired value to correct the process variable to.

logicNodes.label: Control Output
logicNodes.description: The output computed by the controller.

Power_Add.name: Power Add
Power_Add.shortDescription: Combines the outputs of two engines, allowing you to connect multiple engines to the same input.

logicNodes.label: Combined Power
logicNodes.description: Outputs the combined power of engine 1 and 2.

Power_Meter.name: Power Meter
Power_Meter.description: To prevent a loss of power, it should be connected in series between the engine and its receiving component.
Power_Meter.shortDescription: The power meter allows you to take a measurement of how much power is being output from an engine to a specific component.

logicNodes.label: Relay
logicNodes.description: Relays the power received from an engine.

Push_to_Toggle.name: Push to Toggle
Push_to_Toggle.description: This can allow regular push buttons to act as toggle buttons.
Push_to_Toggle.shortDescription: This component has an internal on/off switch that is toggled every time a new on signal is sent to its input.

logicNodes.label: Toggle Signal
logicNodes.description: An on signal toggles the internal on/off switch.

logicNodes.label: Internal State
logicNodes.description: The output of the internal on/off switch.

SR_Latch.name: SR Latch
SR_Latch.description: When both inputs are off, there is no change in state. If both Set and Reset are set to on, Reset will take precedence.
SR_Latch.shortDescription: An SR latch that can be set and reset using two on/off inputs.

logicNodes.label: Set
logicNodes.description: Sets the output to on.

logicNodes.label: Reset
logicNodes.description: Sets the output to off.

logicNodes.label: Output
logicNodes.description: The internal state of the latch.

logicNodes.label: NOT Output
logicNodes.description: The inverse of the internal state of the latch.

Subtract.name: Subtract
Subtract.shortDescription: Takes two number inputs, subtracts the second from first, and outputs the result.

logicNodes.label: A
logicNodes.description: The value to subtract from.

logicNodes.label: B
logicNodes.description: The value to subtract.

logicNodes.label: A - B
logicNodes.description: Outputs the result of subtracting B from A.

Threshold_Gate.name: Threshold Gate
Threshold_Gate.description: A lower and upper bound to the threshold must be set. The output is set to on if the input value is less than or equal to the upper bound, and greater than or equal to the lower bound. If it is outside this range, the output is set to off. The threshold bounds can be configured by selecting this component with the select tool.
Threshold_Gate.shortDescription: Takes a value and compares it to a set threshold.

logicNodes.label: Within Threshold
logicNodes.description: Outputs an on signal when the input value is within the set threshold.

logicNodes.label: Value to Test
logicNodes.description: The value to test within the threshold.

Train_Junction_Controller.name: Train Junction Controller
Train_Junction_Controller.description: This can allow regular push buttons to act as toggle buttons.
Train_Junction_Controller.shortDescription: This component has an internal on/off switch that is toggled every time a new on signal is sent to its input.

logicNodes.label: Toggle Signal
logicNodes.description: An on signal toggles the internal on/off switch.

logicNodes.label: Internal State
logicNodes.description: The output of the internal on/off switch.

Trigonometry.name: Trigonometry
Trigonometry.description: The available functions are sin, cos, tan, asin, acos and atan. If an invalid number is input, the output will be 0. Sin, cos and tan accept inputs measured in turns. Asin, acos and atan output values measured in turns. The function can be set by selecting this component with the select tool.
Trigonometry.shortDescription: Provides a set of basic trigonometry functions.

logicNodes.label: Input Number
logicNodes.description: The input to the function.

logicNodes.label: f(x)
logicNodes.description: f(x), where f is the selected function and x is the input.

Up_Down.name: Up/Down
Up_Down.description: The up input moves the value towards 1, and the down input moves it towards -1. This component can be used for converting on/off button presses into a standard number value that can be used to control any mechanical components that accept a standard number input.
Up_Down.shortDescription: This component uses two on/off signals to move an internal value between -1 and 1.

logicNodes.label: Up
logicNodes.description: Moves the internal value towards 1.

logicNodes.label: Down
logicNodes.description: Moves the internal value towards -1.

logicNodes.label: Up/Down Value
logicNodes.description: The internally stored value between -1 an 1.

Xor.name: Xor
Xor.description: The output will be switched on if only one of the signals are on. The output will be switched off if the two signals are the same.
Xor.shortDescription: A logic gate that outputs the logical XOR of two input signals.

logicNodes.label: A
logicNodes.description: The first value to perform the logical XOR on.

logicNodes.label: B
logicNodes.description: The first value to perform the logical XOR on.

logicNodes.label: A XOR B
logicNodes.description: Outputs an on signal if only A is on, or only B is on. The output is off if A and B are both on or off.

Artificial_Horizon.name: Artificial Horizon
Artificial_Horizon.description: The horizon ball rotates up and down as your vehicle's pitch changes, and the central line gives an indication of your vehicle's roll. This is a useful component to have in your helicopter to make it easier to fly at night and in thick fog. An on/off signal can be used to toggle the backlight.
Artificial_Horizon.shortDescription: The artificial horizon shows you the orientation of your vehicle with respect to the horizon line.

logicNodes.label: Backlight
logicNodes.description: Enables the backlight when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Electric
logicNodes.description: Electrical power connection.

Buzzer.name: Buzzer
Buzzer.description: The type of sound, volume, and pitch can be customised by selecting this component with the select tool. It has an audible range of 30m.
Buzzer.shortDescription: A buzzer that will play a selected sound when toggled from off to on.

logicNodes.label: Buzzer
logicNodes.description: Plays the selected sound when toggled from off to on.

logicNodes.label: Electric
logicNodes.description: Electrical power connection.

Clock.name: Clock
Clock.description: The clock has a display to visualise the time of day or night. The 12 o'clock position is the white arrow on the face of the display.
Clock.shortDescription: An analogue clock display that outputs a number value representing the time of day.

logicNodes.label: Backlight
logicNodes.description: Enables the backlight when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Time
logicNodes.description: The time as a factor of a day, from 0 (midnight) to 1 (midnight).

logicNodes.label: Electric
logicNodes.description: Electrical power connection.

Compass_Ball.name: Compass Ball
Compass_Ball.description: It is one of several tools that can be used to aid navigation in low visibility situations. An on/off signal controls whether or not the compass' backlight is enabled.
Compass_Ball.shortDescription: The compass rotates to point to north on the map.

logicNodes.label: Backlight
logicNodes.description: Enables the backlight when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Electric
logicNodes.description: Electrical power connection.

Dial.name: Dial
Dial.description: The dial's face represents values ranging from -1 to 1 by default. This can be configured by selecting it with the select tool. Values outside this range will cause the needle to wrap around, but can be scaled to fit using additional logic components if necessary. An on/off signal can be used to toggle the backlight.
Dial.shortDescription: A dial with a rotating needle for displaying numerical values.

logicNodes.label: Backlight
logicNodes.description: Enables the backlight when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Value to Display
logicNodes.description: The numerical value to display, ideally scaled to be within a -1 to 1 range.

logicNodes.label: Electric

Digital_Display.name: Digital Display
Digital_Display.description: The position of the decimal point can be configured by selecting this component with the select tool, allowing you to control the number of decimal places in the output.
Digital_Display.shortDescription: Displays a 5 digit (6 with decimal point disabled) signed numerical value with optional decimal point.

logicNodes.label: Backlight
logicNodes.description: Enables the backlight when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Value to Display
logicNodes.description: The numerical value to display.

logicNodes.label: Electric
logicNodes.description: Electrical power connection.

Gauge_Display.name: Gauge Display
Gauge_Display.description: The primary needle is white and the secondary needle is red. The positions of the needles represent values ranging from -1 to 1 by default. This range can be configured by selecting the display with the select tool.
Gauge_Display.shortDescription: A display with two needles that can be positioned independently.

logicNodes.label: Backlight

logicNodes.description: The numerical value that sets the position of the red needle.

HUD_Large.name: HUD Large
HUD_Large.shortDescription: A clear projection heads up display screen.

logicNodes.label: Power Switch
logicNodes.description: Controls whether or not the screen is switched on.

HUD_Small.name: HUD Small
HUD_Small.shortDescription: A clear projection heads up display screen.

logicNodes.label: Power Switch
logicNodes.description: Controls whether or not the screen is switched on.

Indicator_Light.name: Indicator Light
Indicator_Light.shortDescription: A simple light that can be used as an indicator in logic systems.

logicNodes.label: Indicator Light
logicNodes.description: Switches the light on when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Electric
logicNodes.description: Electrical power connection.

Indicator_Light_(RGB).name: Indicator Light (RGB)
Indicator_Light_(RGB).description: Three channels of the composite input can be used to set the red, green and blue components of the indicator's color using numbers between 0 and 1. The light can also operate in HSV mode, where the 3 inputs correspond to the hue, saturation and value (brightness) of the color between 0 and 1. The color mode and input channels can be customised by selecting this component with the select tool.
Indicator_Light_(RGB).shortDescription: An advanced indicator that can be controlled using a microcontroller.

logicNodes.label: Electric
logicNodes.description: Electrical power connection.

logicNodes.label: Color Data
logicNodes.description: Composite link containing the indicator's color data.

Instrument_Panel.name: Instrument Panel
Instrument_Panel.description: The 4 instruments can be selected in the properties window. Each type of instrument has options for choosing the composite channels that they read from or write to. Composite signals are bridged from the input node to the output node to enable displays to be chained together. Instruments marked as '(On/Off)' require multiple on/off signals to control each of their segments individually.
Instrument_Panel.shortDescription: A customisable panel that can have up to 4 different instruments, controlled by a composite signal from a microcontroller.

logicNodes.label: Backlight
logicNodes.description: Enables the backlight when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.description: Input signal containing data to be displayed.

logicNodes.description: Output signal containing data set by buttons on the display.

Laser_Beacon.name: Laser Beacon
Laser_Beacon.shortDescription: A beacon that produces a laser point light, visible by laser point sensors.

logicNodes.description: Switches the beacon on when receiving an on signal.

Paintable_Indicator.name: Paintable Indicator
Paintable_Indicator.description: This block has a paintable surface where small grid squares can be painted individually. Use additive painting mode to paint the backlight grid. The backlight can be enabled by using an on signal and a name can be set with the select tool that will be visible when the indicator is looked at by a player.
Paintable_Indicator.shortDescription: A backlit indicator for displaying painted detail.

logicNodes.label: Backlight
logicNodes.description: Switches the backlight on when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Electric
logicNodes.description: Electrical power connection.

Paintable_Sign.name: Paintable Sign
Paintable_Sign.description: This block has a paintable surface where small grid squares can be painted individually.
Paintable_Sign.shortDescription: Sign block for displaying painted detail.

Speaker_(Small).name: Speaker (Small)
Speaker_(Small).description: A small speaker capable of playing audio data to nearby players. (Range : 15)
Speaker_(Small).shortDescription: A speaker capable of playing audio data to players within its range.

logicNodes.label: Is Transmit
logicNodes.description: If the speaker is currently transmitting.

logicNodes.description: Audio data connection.

Viewing_Scope.name: Viewing Scope
Viewing_Scope.description: Interact to display video data at full detail.

logicNodes.label: Occupied
logicNodes.description: Outputs an on signal if this viewing scope is occupied by a character.

Altimeter.name: Altimeter
Altimeter.description: Outputs distance above sea-level in meters.

logicNodes.label: Altitude
logicNodes.description: The measured altitude of the component in metres above sea-level.

Angular_Speed_Sensor.name: Angular Speed Sensor
Angular_Speed_Sensor.description: This sensor outputs the angular speed of the component about the component's y axis.
Angular_Speed_Sensor.shortDescription: This sensor outputs its current angular speed in rotations per second, allowing you to measure how fast your vehicle is rotating.

logicNodes.label: Angular Speed
logicNodes.description: The sensor's angular speed in rotations per second.

Astronomy_Sensor.name: Astronomy Sensor
Astronomy_Sensor.description: Outputs relative position data based on the optimal target trajectory between the earth and moon.
Astronomy_Sensor.shortDescription: A sensor that provides raw space navigation data.

logicNodes.label: Data
logicNodes.description: Outputs [1] x position in metres, [2] y position in metres (earth sea level is 0), [3] z position in metres, [4] euler rotation x, [5] euler rotation y, [6] euler rotation z, [7] angular velocity x, [8] angular velocity y, [9] angular velocity z, [10] local z tilt and [11] local x tilt to the respective composite channels.

Compass_Sensor.name: Compass Sensor
Compass_Sensor.description: The sensor has a display to visualise the direction of north. The measured output is taken relative to the white arrow on the face of the display.
Compass_Sensor.shortDescription: A digital compass that outputs a number value representing the turn that must be made for it to face north.

logicNodes.label: Backlight
logicNodes.description: Enables the backlight when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Compass Reading
logicNodes.description: The angle measured in turns that the needle is rotated from the white arrow on the display.

logicNodes.label: Electric
logicNodes.description: Electrical power connection.

Contact_Sensor.name: Contact Sensor
Contact_Sensor.description: Setting the resistance property will tune the amount of contact required to depress the sensor. When depressed, an on signal will be produced.
Contact_Sensor.shortDescription: A sensor activated by contact pressure.

logicNodes.label: Output
logicNodes.description: Outputs an on signal when the contact sensor is depressed.

Distance_Sensor.name: Distance Sensor
Distance_Sensor.description: The reading can be read from the sensor's number output and is measured in metres (1 metre = 4 blocks).
Distance_Sensor.shortDescription: A laser distance sensor with a maximum measurement range of 500m.

logicNodes.label: Distance
logicNodes.description: The measured distance in metres.

logicNodes.label: Electric
logicNodes.description: Electrical power connection.

Fishfinder.name: Fishfinder
Fishfinder.description: This sensor outputs the relative angle, distance and depth to a random detected fish within its range using sound waves when submerged.
Fishfinder.shortDescription: A sensor that returns information about a fish within 100m when submerged.

logicNodes.label: Activate
logicNodes.description: Enable the Fishfinder.

logicNodes.label: Electric
logicNodes.description: Electrical power connection.

logicNodes.label: Fish Data
logicNodes.description: Outputs data for a detected fish. On/Off 1: Returns true when a fish is detected. Value 1: The yaw angle between the sensor and the detected fish measured in turns, Value 2: The horizontal distance from the sensor to the detected fish measured in metres, Value 3: The depth from the sensor to the fish measured in metres.

Gas_Meter.name: Gas Meter
Gas_Meter.description: This will output a quantity in litres and the total capacity in litres.
Gas_Meter.shortDescription: A device to measure how much gas is within an enclosed volume.

logicNodes.label: Gas Level
logicNodes.description: Returns the number of litres of gas in an enclosed volume.

logicNodes.label: Fluid Capacity
logicNodes.description: Returns the total capacity of an enclosed volume in litres, or 0 if not enclosed.

logicNodes.label: Composite Data
logicNodes.description: Outputs the volumes of individual gas types on their respective channel. The data can be directly merged with a Liquid meter. The Air fluid type is equivalent to the sum of the oxygen, carbon dioxide and nitrogen values. Channels: 4-Air, 5-CO2, 8-Steam, 11-Oxygen, 12-Nitrogen, 13-Hydrogen.

GPS_Sensor.name: GPS Sensor
GPS_Sensor.description: The coordinates represent an offset from the centre of the world, measured in metres. You can check the world coordinates of any location by looking at your map.
GPS_Sensor.shortDescription: Outputs its x and y world coordinates according to its location on the map.

logicNodes.label: X Coordinate
logicNodes.description: The x coordinate of this component on the world map.

logicNodes.label: Y Coordinate
logicNodes.description: The y coordinate of this component on the world map.

logicNodes.label: Electric
logicNodes.description: Electrical power connection.

Humidity_Sensor.name: Humidity Sensor
Humidity_Sensor.description: The reading can be read from the sensor's number output and is measured from 0 (no fog) to 1 (max fog).
Humidity_Sensor.shortDescription: A humidity sensor for measuring the current fog and visibility meteorological conditions.

logicNodes.label: Humidity Factor
logicNodes.description: The level of humidity in the air, relating to the fog visibility.

Impact_Sensor.name: Impact Sensor
Impact_Sensor.description: Setting the impact threshold property will tune the sensitivity for impacts. When the instant change in velocity from an impact exceeds the threshold, an on signal is produced.
Impact_Sensor.shortDescription: A sensor activated by a sudden change in velocity.

logicNodes.label: Output
logicNodes.description: Outputs an on signal when instant change in velocity exceeds the impact threshold.

Laser_Distance_Sensor.name: Laser Distance Sensor
Laser_Distance_Sensor.description: The reading can be read from the sensor's number output and is measured in metres (1 metre = 4 blocks). Can be pivoted up to 0.125 turns using composite input.
Laser_Distance_Sensor.shortDescription: A laser distance sensor with a maximum measurement range of 4000m.

logicNodes.label: Active

logicNodes.label: Wavelength

logicNodes.label: Pivot

Laser_Point_Sensor.name: Laser Point Sensor
Laser_Point_Sensor.description: The closest point to the center of the sensor's field of view will be reported. It outputs a value of -1 to 1 on composite number channel 1 for the x position, and a value of -1 to 1 on composite number channel 2 for the y position. Composite on/off channel 1 is set to on when a point is visible. The -1 to 1 values map to an fov of -cos(0.5) to cos(0.5) in both the x and y directions.
Laser_Point_Sensor.shortDescription: A sensor that outputs a relative x and y position of a laser point that it can see within its field of view.

logicNodes.label: Wavelength
logicNodes.description: The specific light wavelength to detect (whole number).

logicNodes.label: Electric
logicNodes.description: Electrical power connection.

logicNodes.label: Data Output
logicNodes.description: On/Off channel 1: is laser detected. Number channel 1, 2: X, Y position within the sensors 120 degree field of view.

Laser_Sensor_(Missile).name: Laser Sensor (Missile)
Laser_Sensor_(Missile).description: This sensor is designed for missiles and acts along the Z axis, with an output node that passes data to course correct linked rocket fin components toward the closest target. The sensor also outputs data for up to 8 detected laser points.
Laser_Sensor_(Missile).shortDescription: A short range sensor that returns information about detected laser points within its view.

logicNodes.label: Activate
logicNodes.description: Enable the Laser Sensor.

logicNodes.label: Wavelength
logicNodes.description: The specific light wavelength to detect (whole number).

logicNodes.label: Electric
logicNodes.description: Electrical power connection.

logicNodes.label: Sensor Data
logicNodes.description: Outputs data for up to 8 targets. On/Off 1-8 : Target 1 Found, Target 2 Found, etc... Values 1-32 : Target 1 Distance, Target 1 Azimuth Angle, Target 1 Elevation Angle, Target 1 Time Since Detection, Target 2 Distance, Target 2 Azimuth Angle, Target 2 Elevation Angle, Target 2 Time Since Detection, etc...

logicNodes.label: Missile Output
logicNodes.description: Outputs yaw and pitch rotations toward the most immediate target. (Value 1 : Yaw) (Value 2 : Pitch). Link this directly into a rocket fins component.

Linear_Speed_Sensor.name: Linear Speed Sensor
Linear_Speed_Sensor.description: This sensor outputs the speed of the component in one of 4 modes. Modes can be changed by selecting the sensor.
Linear_Speed_Sensor.shortDescription: This sensor outputs its current linear speed in m/s, allowing you to measure how fast your vehicle is travelling.

logicNodes.label: Linear Speed
logicNodes.description: The sensor's linear speed in m/s.

Liquid_Meter.name: Liquid Meter
Liquid_Meter.description: This will output a quantity in litres and the total capacity in litres. If not inside an enclosed volume, it will give the height relative to the water surface.
Liquid_Meter.shortDescription: A device to measure how much liquid is within an enclosed volume.

Microphone.name: Microphone

In order to drill effectively a drill rod should be driven by a rotary table and forced downward toward the terrain. A continuous supply of drilling slurry must be provided through the drill rod via a swivel, and the saturated drilling slurry extracted from the well head fluid port.
Oil_Rig_Well_Head.shortDescription: A well head for oil drilling.
